description: This source file defines a grain class for the Orleans distributed application framework that manages stream subscription with fault injection for testing recoverability. It contains logic for handling stream events, errors, fault injection, and state management within a grain.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscription_NonTransientError_RecoverableStream_CollectorGrain
classes.description: A grain class that subscribes to a stream, processes events with fault injection and state management, and reports results. It uses Orleans stream subscription mechanisms, maintains fault state, and handles event duplication and checkpointing.

classes.name: FaultsState
classes.description: A nested class representing the fault state for individual stream processing, including whether a fault has been cleared.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes the grain upon activation: reads state, sets up stream subscription.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream events, performs duplicate detection, fault injection, checkpointing, and reporting.

methods.name: OnErrorAsync
methods.description: Handles stream errors and clears fault status.

methods.name: InjectFault
methods.description: Injects a fault by throwing an exception, used to test fault recovery.
